items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: And we were at one time, we went over to that place to play for the old man.

ctx.x: I mean, he's pretty long. Yeah, I never did know him. He was a bass player.

Well, they used to have a professor, they used to teach music. I think his name was Barnett. He was a bass player. And the whole family played music. And we were at one time, we went over to that place to play for the old man. And I remember the old man being a teacher in legitimate music. It was just amazing to him to see how he played so well without using notes, you know what I mean? And everything from memory and completely dependent upon the air. To him, that was quite a sensation. And Brookhoven, I remember…
